$comment: Reviews + sample calls (tools/build_landing.py section_reviews). FTC rule on fake reviews (16 CFR 465, 2024): never add a review that a real client did not write. RULE: the 'What clients say' section renders ONLY when "reviews" holds at least 2 approved reviews (consent: true); with fewer it is omitted entirely, and there are no empty 'your review here' placeholders. The 'What a call sounds like' strip (from the page's demo, labeled Sample) always shows. Review shape: {"name", "business", "city" (City, ST), "text" (verbatim), "source_url" (link to the original review), "date" (YYYY-MM-DD), "consent": true, optional "rating" 1-5}. A review without consent: true is ignored; a consented one with a missing field stops the build. Test: tools/landing_test.py.
